title: Telephony Call Started Event
description: A call began: an inbound call reached one of the operator's numbers (including calls the personal cell forwards to Telnyx when busy or unanswered), or an outbound call was placed. ordering_key is call:<call_id>. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (telephony).

call_id.description: Provider call identifier (Telnyx call_control_id or TeXML CallSid). Every event of one call carries the same value; ordering_key is call:<call_id>.

line.description: The operator line involved: 'cell' (the personal Verizon line, forwarded), or the E.164 of a Telnyx number.

direction.description: inbound: a call to the operator's line; outbound: a call the operator's line placed.

forwarded_from.description: The number that forwarded the call here (e.g. the personal cell via Verizon *71), when the carrier passes it.

started_at.description: When the call was set up.

command_id.description: command_id of the telephony.call.start command, for outbound calls it caused.
